title: How to Actually Stick to Your Gym Membership in NZ — Practical Tips
meta_desc: Sticking to gym memberships in NZ, discover habit formation and accountability strategies
intro: With many NZ gym memberships costing between $15-$30 per week, such as Anytime Fitness and Jetts, it can be frustrating to not see results due to poor attendance. Forming habits and being accountable are crucial to achieving your fitness goals. Let's explore practical tips to help you stick to your gym membership.

sections.heading: Forming Habits
sections.body: To create a gym routine, start by scheduling specific times to visit the gym each week. This could be early in the morning before work or straight after dinner. Consistency is key, so try to visit the gym at the same time every day or week to make it a habit. For example, if you join a gym like Les Mills with over 40 locations across NZ, you can choose a gym close to your work or home to make it easier to stick to your routine.

sections.heading: Accountability Strategies
list: Exercise with a friend or family member
Join a fitness class or group training session
Find a workout buddy online or through social media

sections.heading: Price Comparison of Popular NZ Gyms
Making the Most of Your Membership
sections.body: Many gyms in NZ offer additional services such as personal training sessions, group fitness classes, and nutritional advice. For example, a gym like Jetts offers a free 7-day trial, allowing you to try out their facilities and services before committing to a membership. With a membership costing $15.95 per week, it's an affordable option for those looking to try out a new gym.
